description: Where the Reorder Report receiver gets its shared secret. Exists because Frappe Cloud's Site Config dialog will not always accept a custom key — this is editable from Desk by a System Manager instead.

fields.label: Accept Reorder Report Imports
fields.description: Untick to stop accepting exports without changing the token.

fields.label: Import Token
fields.description: Shared secret Tally must send. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Anyone holding this can post reorder data to the site, so treat it as a password and change it if it leaks.

fields.options:
In TallyPrime, open the Reorder Report, press E: Export and set Export to: Web portal, File Format: XML (Data Interchange), Secure Server: Yes, with this URL:

https://<your-site>/api/method/tally_bridge.reorder_import.receive?token=<the token above>

Each export is stored under Tally Reorder Import with its raw XML kept verbatim, and the levels land in Tally Reorder Level. A payload that fails to parse is still stored, so nothing is lost — it can be re-read later.

name: Tally Reorder Settings
